The upstream capability baseline at the locked tag is the complete presentation-diagram discipline: typed JSON schemas for ten diagram modes, the deterministic `validate`/`deliver`/`finalize` CLI with real-browser checks, the viewer runtime, the authoring/delivery contracts, and the update-awareness rule. The package is vendored from the upstream `super-archify/` subtree with two exclusions recorded in the compatibility map — the fifteen pre-rendered example HTML files and `package-lock.json` (dev-only); `node bin/archify.mjs doctor` passes all 25 checks on the trimmed package, and every vendored file's SHA-256 is pinned in the complete digest manifest `tests/archify-vendor-manifest.json`.
